status: READY (result-skeptic round 2, 11/05, with three doc fixes applied); nothing scored
operator: 2026-11-05 'yes - we're trying to eliminate the Nevergreens ... identify flat sideways movement and not open on it'
question: Do any of six price/tape shape measures over the 15 closed minutes before entry mark desk entries that go never-green more often, and does refusing that flat quarter raise the mean of the kept trades?
prior_evidence_against: sideways_filter 10/16: 30-bar signed efficiency ratio (TRER) and CHOP on PRE onsets UNDERPOWERED / not promising (different target: forward return at signals, not never-green on desk fills)
never_green_entry 11/04: scalar entry facts AUC 0.55 (no price-shape features were in it)
sideways %R test 11/04: z +1.5, 58 of 75 cases in one period
quiet-tape gate works only on real-time SIP volume; IEX volume flat (tape5 is IEX)
population: desk watch-path entries >= $20, 2026-09-24..2026-10-30; last closed bar within 180 s of the entry minute (code: cut-180) and 15 bars spanning <= 18 min; >= 80 IEX bars cached
label: never_green = peak_price < entry_price x 1.0005 (hold-length dependent; stated limitation). net = (exit-entry)/entry bp - 3 bp.

measures_fixed.er15: |close[-1]-close[0]| / sum|diff| over the last 15 CLOSED bars (15 closes, the last closed bar close is the final close); SIDEWAYS = low
measures_fixed.rng15: (max high - min low of those 15 bars) / last closed close in bp; SIDEWAYS = low
measures_fixed.r2_15: R^2 of a straight-line fit to those 15 closes; SIDEWAYS = low
measures_fixed.vwap15_crossings: count of close-vs-running-VWAP (VWAP over the 15 bars) side changes; SIDEWAYS = high
measures_fixed.bbw20: 4 x population stdev of last 20 closed closes / mean, bp; SIDEWAYS = low

flat_group: worst quarter in the declared direction; cut = pooled 25th (or 75th) percentile of the measure over all scored entries (label-free)

pass.never_green: flat quarter never-green rate higher than the rest in pooled, half A (< 2026-10-14) and half B (>= 2026-10-14), pooled one-sided z >= 2.40 (p < 0.05/6)
pass.payoff: mean net of the three kept quarters > mean net of all entries in pooled, A and B

verdicts: PASS_NG_AND_PAYOFF (live-log it forward, no block until 150 forward entries), PASS_NG_ONLY (information), FAIL
no_retuning: no thresholds, windows, or measure definitions changed after scoring; a failure closes this study
if_pass: stamp the passing measure on live entries (observe only), read at 150 forward entries with the same bar; block nothing before that
if_fail: close; record in running list and memory; the shape of the last 15 minutes does not separate never-greens

amended_1.label: never_green = no IEX 1-min bar starting in (entry_time, +300 s] has high >= entry_price x 1.0005 (fixed horizon). peak_price label reported as cross-check only.
amended_1.measures: tape5 dropped (IEX volume known flat); 5 measures, Bonferroni z >= 2.33. vwapx15 renamed vwap15_crossings (VWAP over the 15 bars, not session). Final close = last CLOSED bar close, not the broker fill. bbw20 gets a contiguity check.
amended_1.population: 2026-09-24..2026-10-30 (11/02, 11/03 excluded as in never_green_entry; 10/26-10/30 rates were seen by the operator). Halves A <2026-10-14, B >=.
amended_1.cut: fit on half A only, applied to B. Ties: flat = value <= cut (low) or >= cut (high); flat share must be 20-30% in ALL, A and B or the verdict is ABORT_SHARE.
amended_1.volatility_confound: never-green must also be higher for flat inside rng15 terciles (>= 2 of 3 positive) - rng15 itself is exempt.
amended_1.pass: NG: pooled z >= 2.33, flat > rest in A and B, day-clustered bootstrap 5th pct of (flat - rest) NG rate > 0. PAYOFF: day-clustered bootstrap 5th pct of (kept - all) net > 0 AND its median beats a random same-count-per-day skip. PASS_NG_AND_PAYOFF needs both.
amended_1.power: ~700 entries expected, flat ~90 per half: minimum detectable NG lift ~10 points per half; true effect likely smaller (scalar-fact AUC was 0.55). A half with < 80 flat entries gives UNDERPOWERED.
amended_1.diagnostics: drop counts by reason printed; abort below 300 scored entries.
amended_1.known_limits: IEX sparsity: thin names print fewer bars, which lowers rng15/er15/bbw20 and also the chance a +5 bp high prints, so rng15 has no tercile protection. Bootstrap control may skip slightly more than the flat count on duplicated days (noise only). Expected ~88 flat per half, so UNDERPOWERED is a likely verdict; the 80 floor is not changed.
